items.text: OUT-001 has an identified project scope and frozen accepted node inventory, explicit semantics/direction/rules, appropriate FULL_GRAPH coverage posture, and visible missing evidence/exemptions under REQ-001. Verify by VER-001.

verification.text: Compare the graph basis and node inventory to the accepted decomposition and recorded tracking mode. Check missing-register nodes, exemptions and coverage limitations as well as edge objective and direction. Evidence: identified inventory comparison and basis package, with discrepancies retained. [B1, B3, B5]

items.text: OUT-001 relationships and interface records retain the required contribution and condition, source standing and satisfaction, with complete source provenance, declaration/extraction distinction, fidelity and mirror treatment under REQ-002. Verify by VER-002.

verification.text: Trace represented rows to the frozen local source manifest, source identifiers and applicable contracts. Check contribution/condition/standing/satisfaction fields, original core-field fidelity, declared-origin mirroring, representative/mirror accounting and conflicts routed to both owners. Evidence: source manifest, row accounting/fidelity results and findings. [B3, B5]

items.text: OUT-001 represents required external inputs and open choices at their actual points of need, preserves owner and project identity, and allows a pending external contribution within the graph without declaring its consumer ready or imposing a blanket graph-acceptance prerequisite under REQ-003. Verify by VER-003.

verification.text: Compare the interface account and excluded non-topological relationships with current relevant external and open-issue source rows. Inspect pending-input cases and confirm owners, point of need, limitations and distinct supplier-project identity survive. Specifically examine pending SWB delivery, optional/unqualified PEC, later Domains with unresolved allocation, and supplier/adoption dependencies; verify that graph acceptance neither waits for all external completion nor implies dependent-input satisfaction. Evidence: cited interface comparison and receiving limitations. [B1, B4, B8, B9]

items.text: OUT-002 identifies coverage and closure on the graph's frozen basis; admitted edges pass the selected strict canonical audit, accounting balances and held cyclic relationships retain their cases and actual work constraints under REQ-004. Verify by VER-004.

verification.text: Inspect the frozen-basis closure report, inventory coverage and SCC cases; run the selected `audit_dag.py --canonical --strict` on the admitted graph and preserve command, tool identity, exit/result and input hashes. Reconcile all active execution rows and copied-field fidelity. Check that held candidates are non-gating, affected missing-input work remains held, and resolved cases cite subsequent closure. Evidence: audit/closure/accounting outputs and case dispositions, with process success separate from subject pass. These future graph checks are not run against this INIT contract. [B5, B6]

items.text: OUT-002 preserves the concrete basis and version decision packages, separate independent review and candidate-bound disposition of findings under REQ-005; preparation and tool success remain distinguishable from human decisions. Verify by VER-005.

verification.text: An examiner separate from graph assembly compares the candidate with the confirmed basis, reruns applicable manifest/strict-audit/accounting/fidelity checks, examines semantics, exclusions, mirrors and held work, and records blocking/non-blocking findings. Compare each checkpoint package and decision subject with the checked candidate and any changed basis. Evidence: independent review, repairs/backchecks and presented subject identities; no claim of human acceptance from a review pass. [B5]

items.text: OUT-002 acceptance and publication evidence faithfully records actual human acts and matches the presented graph hashes, immutable version, manifest and handoff under REQ-006. An unaccepted candidate, absent decision or changed subject cannot be presented as accepted. Verify by VER-006.

verification.text: Reconcile the decision question, actual answer, actor and custody with the presented hashes and published snapshot/pointer. Positive case: a recording agent faithfully records an actually performed human acceptance or qualified acceptance, identifying the human decision actor and disclosed relay limits. Negative cases: an agent proposal/audit is relabelled acceptance, missing actor or date is invented, an unseen changed graph is published under an earlier act, or an observation pointer is treated as accepted. Evidence: actual decision record, presentation hashes and manifest comparison; unavailable decision evidence remains unresolved. [B1, B3, B5]

items.text: OUT-002 currency and handoff evidence correctly separates unchanged/evidence-drift states from departure/incomplete states, identifies affected DAG-pending deliverables and subsequent decisions, preserves unaffected reliance and history, and requires no session-driven rebuild under REQ-007. Verify by VER-007.

verification.text: Examine currency comparisons against the accepted inventory, admitted/candidate arcs and SCCs. Check unchanged and evidence-only drift treatment, arc/inventory/SCC departures, unreadable sources, human acceptance/rejection, unchanged rejected rows, and later changed rows. Verify affected pending flags and no ready/blocked verdict while pending, unchanged accepted snapshots, scoped successor decisions, live satisfaction reading and handoff. Evidence: source comparison, currency report, decision and successor/predecessor links as applicable. [B5, B7]

items.text: Both outputs preserve the contract/input, project-DAG/work-graph and graph-acceptance/30%-decision distinctions of REQ-008, allow supported initial definition before the first DAG, and make no readiness or supplied-input claim from INITIALIZED alone. Verify by VER-008.

verification.text: Inspect the handoff and reliance statements against B3 and the owning production evidence. Trace the cases of an INITIALIZED contract with an absent artifact, pre-DAG definition, a held unresolved cycle, and a graph accepted with pending dependencies. Confirm each retains its actual next condition without a self-bootstrap prerequisite or invented 30%/lifecycle/release/reliance act. Evidence: source-grounded readiness/reliance examination. [B1–B3, B5–B7, B10]

items.text: Both outputs preserve the one-for-one excluded-act owners of REQ-009, with no transferred supplier, sibling, amendment or human responsibility; preparation, examination, decision and faithful recording retain their actual actors and evidence. Verify by VER-009.

verification.text: Enumerate each excluded act in REQ-009 and match it to CLM-001, CLM-002 or CLM-003 and its cited source owner. Inspect actual assignments, decisions and records for responsibility transfer or fabrication; retain faithful recording of a performed act as a permitted case. Deterministic local-owner resolution assists this comparison but cannot authenticate actors or prove the semantic boundary. Evidence: owner-resolution report plus semantic examination and any routed conflict. [B1, B3–B9]
